heading: Definitions

tree.heading: Board
tree.text: The term “Board” means the Board of Directors of the Corporation.

tree.heading: Campus director
tree.text: The term “campus director”, with respect to a Corps campus, means the head of the campus under section 12615(d) of this title.

tree.heading: Corps
tree.text: The term “Corps” means the National Civilian Community Corps required under section 12615 of this title as part of the National Civilian Community Corps Program.

tree.heading: Corps campus
tree.text: The term “Corps campus” means the facility or central location established as the operational headquarters and boarding place for particular Corps units.

tree.heading: Corps members
tree.text: The term “Corps members” means persons receiving training and participating in projects under the National Civilian Community Corps Program.

tree.heading: Director
tree.text: The term “Director” means the Director of the National Civilian Community Corps.

tree.heading: Institution of higher education
tree.text: The term “institution of higher education” has the meaning given that term in section 1001 of title 20.

tree.heading: Program
tree.text: The term “Program” means the National Civilian Community Corps Program established pursuant to section 12612 of this title.

tree.heading: Service-learning
tree.text: The term “service-learning”, with respect to Corps members, means a method—

children.text: under which Corps members learn and develop through active participation in thoughtfully organized service experiences that meet actual community needs;
that provides structured time for a Corps member to think, talk, or write about what the Corps member did and saw during an actual service activity;
that provides Corps members with opportunities to use newly acquired skills and knowledge in real life situations in their own communities; and
that helps to foster the development of a sense of caring for others, good citizenship, and civic responsibility.

tree.heading: Unit
tree.text: The term “unit” means a unit of the Corps referred to in section 12615(c) of this title.

notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Section was formerly classified to section 12653o of this title prior to renumbering by Pub. L. 103–82, § 104(b).
